mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising, it indicates a broad-based expansion in consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions characterized by low and falling unemployment, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as the economy approaches its peak and corporate earnings growth remains robust.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5% and falling, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, which typically precedes positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 95, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth follows the economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 rises (compared to previous quarter), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
